280532557ce00cf81a6cde850fd4ba96.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Nampho Shipyard
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the Nampho Shipyard on November 2.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the C.C., WPK.
He was greeted at the shipyard by leading officials of the Shipbuilding Institute and the shipyard.

The Nampho Shipyard is pushing ahead with the project to modernize its overall production lines and also making progress in the building of a new warship, under the tasks of the warship building sector set forth by the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK and the decision made at the First Enlarged Meeting of the WPK Central Military Commission.
Comrade Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the master plan for updating the shipyard and then about the economic organization for the modernization project and the progress in the project.

He referred once again to the opinion of the WPK Central Committee on the historical need to accelerate the expansion of capacity of the Nampho Shipyard and other major shipyards and their technical upgrading.

The strategy for developing the shipbuilding industry set forth by the Party Congress clearly indicates the specific orientation for expanding the capacity of the existing shipyards and increasing the operation rate of all the shipyards, he said, adding that the implementation of this strategy means the updating of major infrastructure of the state which is of key importance in rapidly developing the country's marine industry for the future economic prospect, defending the security of the sea border and maritime sovereignty and exercising the strategic deterrent.

In particular, it is vital and important requirement of the times to rapidly bolster up the surface and underwater combat power for defending the national sovereignty in the sea under various threats, he said. Stating that the necessity to completely upgrade the combat power of the navy at present is attributable to the circumstances which compels us to contain the nuclear blackmail and threat of the enemies in the region, the source of creating the new geopolitical situation and substantially and gravely affecting the national security, he said that the timely adopted development plan in the shipbuilding industrial sector is a responsible option in view of the national prosperity and security and an expression of action for the just will to ensure the prosperity and development of the country and defend its peace.

Saying that the advanced and hi-tech shipbuilding base is essential for building a powerful naval force which no one can provoke, Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed the need for the shipyard to set the standard goal of modernization in terms of raising the higher efficiency in the aspects of quality and productivity and in the direction of saving manpower and establish an intelligent integrated production system which comprehensively controls the whole course of shipbuilding, thus opening a new path and creating model experience in the development of the shipbuilding industry.

He set forth the important principle and tasks for modernizing the shipyard, including the issues of highly automating all the elements of production process, constructing one more ground dock to create the capacity for building and repairing ships at the same time, and correcting the irrational matters in the layout of the shipyard's buildings.
He also stressed the need to pay due attention to employing more promising talented persons in the field of designing and building the ships and increasing the number of those engaged in that field.

Saying that our inviolable maritime sovereignty is guaranteed only by the most responsible efforts and practical and advanced defence technology, he affirmed that if all shipyards of the country are modernized as planned by the Party Central Committee, a great revolution will take place in the development of the shipbuilding industry.
That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the warship building site of the Nampho Shipyard.

He said that the building of latest-type warships in succession is a proof of the actual development of our shipbuilding sector, which increases confidence in the prosperity and development of our shipbuilding industry. He noted that if the talented shipbuilding group is combined with excellent advanced technology at once, our country will take a seat on the front row of the world's most powerful shipbuilding industry.
He expressed great satisfaction, looking at a warship under construction which is incomparably huge and browbeating than the destroyer built last year.

The new warship, designed to carry out its complex operational mission in consideration of the present-day warfare, the world trend of development and the specific situation of our country on the basis of comprehensive analysis of the development history of warships which many countries have updated through many repeated research in the historical changes, is being built into a combat system with the one and only capabilities from the designing stage, he said, referring to the important military significance of an aggregate of the huge combat power.

Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed that the necessity to possess the most developed and powerful warship is proved without words by the recent geopolitical environment and hostile acts of the enemies, and therefore, the urgency is being highlighted than ever before and it is because we should defend the country, ensure sovereignty and deter all threats.

He asked the workers of the Nampho Shipyard and all the builders involved in the modernization of the shipyard to respond to the sacred mission entrusted by the revolution with their consistent devotion and responsible efforts for the security and prosperity of the country.

His field guidance to the Nampho Shipyard serves as a warm encouragement to the development and might of our shipbuilding industry, which is playing a key role in attaining the strategic target for developing the national industry and bolstering up the national defence capabilities through radical leap forward and revolutionary acceleration, and a significant occasion in adding confidence and courage to its sky-high spirit and advance. -0-

84c7cd4e912ccd4915c8b2f6b827eb7c.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Tenth Congress of UAWK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the Tenth Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea on November 9.

All the participants paid high tribute to Comrade Kim Jong Un as a token of their deep thanks to him who ushered in a great new era of socialist rural development and has bestowed profound trust and honour upon the agricultural workers' union so that it can play the role of an advance unit, the vanguard in it.
Comrade Kim Jong Un congratulated the chairman and the vice-chairmen of the Tenth Central Committee of the UAWK elected at the congress.

He extended warm encouragement to the participants who fully demonstrated the firm faith of the agricultural workers, determined to always remain loyal to the ideology and leadership of the Party, through the congress, which was held in the first year for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Party, the significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the UAWK, and glorified the congress as an occasion for making new leaps forward in the gigantic transformation of all rural villages across the country.

Saying that the patriotic farm workers of the country, who single-mindedly upheld the intention of the Party and shared their destiny with the country, have firmly propelled the advance of the socialist cause with increased grain production for the past five years, too, he highly appreciated the great efforts and exploits of the agricultural workers and UAWK members who dedicate their pure civic conscience and sweat to every field of socialist farms.

Stressing that the Party Central Committee remains unshakable in its plan and decision to make the faithful agricultural workers enjoy the benefits of ideal society, highly civilized and prosperous, earlier than anyone else as they are the direct embodiments and implementers of the immutable revolutionary principle that rice just means socialism and communism, he underlined the need for the UAWK to play the role of the ideological agitator and vanguard that accelerates the rural development, mindful of the original heavy duty it has assumed in the historic course of opening up a new stage in the state development.

Noting that it is the primary duty of the UAWK in the period of the new long-term plan to further accelerate the drive for revolutionizing the rural areas in terms of ideology, technology and culture, he urged the UAWK to thoroughly ensure the implementation of the Party policy by promoting its qualitative development and constantly enhancing its activity and working efficiency, as required by the current reality witnessing unprecedented changes in socialist rural construction.

He had a photo taken with the participants, expressing expectation and belief that they would successfully carry out their honourable mission and duty for the times and the revolution by regarding the programme for rural revolution in the new era as signpost for innovation and progress and turning all the organizations of the union into strong ones for implementing the Party's plan.

The participants in the congress made a firm pledge to tangibly contribute to the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism by dedicating their redoubled effort and great executive faculty to bringing about a drastic turn in the union's work. -0-

86248138bcbdc42fce2d1a575777bfc0.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Newly-built Modern Residential Quarters in Thongchon County of Kangwon Province
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 12 (KCNA) -- A thousand and tens of new modern houses have appeared in the township and several ris of Thongchon County situated on the east coast, where the construction of a large-scale naval base is going on, visualizing the noble view on people of the Workers' Party of Korea which gives top priority to the interests and convenience of the people in administrating all the state affairs. They are near to an auspicious event for moving into new houses.

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the completed new modern residential quarters in Thongchon County of Kangwon Province on Nov. 11.
He was greeted on the spot by senior officials of the construction headquarters and commanding officials of all the provincial shock brigades of Party members involved in the construction.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction, enjoying a bird's-eye view of the modern residential quarters in the township of Thongchon County wonderfully built in a little over two months.

He appreciated that the appearance of new residential quarters in good harmony with different types of low- and multi-story dwelling houses shows another valuable achievement made at a time when the regional construction is being expanded and intensified across the country.

Noting that the internal structure of houses was regarded as of great importance to further promote the convenience of residents and their external shapes are diverse and peculiar, he said that the requirement of the Party's regional construction policy on maintaining the principle of modernity, culture, innovation and diversity in regional construction has been correctly met.

In order to make the implementation of our Party's policy on regional development and the rural housing construction steadily lead to successful outcome amid the active support of all the people across the country, it is an important requirement for the construction sector to consider the work for implementing the Party's plan and decisions in a scientific and economic way and correctly carry them out, he said, adding: The figure of growth symbolic of regional change is important for us, but deeper attention should be paid to the material and cultural well-being and the level of civilization of the regional people being more quantitatively improved and efflorescing every year.

The work to eliminate the differences between town and countryside and definitely ensure the environment for simultaneous, multiple and balanced development in the country is put into practice and proved through construction, the main sphere of our revolution, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, adding that the attitude toward our Party's construction policy on attaching importance to the three elements of design, construction work and building materials is just a touchstone for estimating the viewpoint on the future of the revolution.

He pointed out that the importance of the position and role of the construction sector in helping the people feel the changing times and new thriving in practice life is being stressed whenever an opportunity presents itself, but various evils still appear in regional construction.

Noting that despite several warnings that the design and construction control sectors failed to guarantee the implementation of the Party's construction policy with innovative insight and responsible practice in particular, they have not yet been awakened and have failed to eradicate unscientific formalism and unrealistic stylish manner in regional construction including the rural housing construction, and so on, he analyzed the causes in various aspects.

Saying that the Party's standpoint that strengthening the local areas is the one of our national power and socialism is firm and the construction project for Regional Development 20x10 Policy and the construction of modern houses according to the programme for the rural revolution are important revolutionary tasks to be carried out unconditionally and without fail, he clarified again the important principles and ways to be adhered to in the regional construction.

Comrade Kim Jong Un highly appreciated that the provincial shock brigades of Party members involved in the construction of new modern residential quarters in Thongchon County set a good example in regional construction, deeply conscious that giving precedence to the construction of dwelling houses for the evacuees prior to the major policy construction project is a political undertaking to maintain the consistent principle of our Party giving top priority to the interests and convenience of the people. He expressed satisfaction over the fact that thanks to the vanguard and revolutionary struggle of the shock brigades of Party members, our Party could push ahead with the implementation of the huge military policy for building a naval base.
That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un met members of the provincial shock brigades of Party members and warmly encouraged them.

Expressing expectation and belief that the members of the shock brigades of Party members possessed of ardent loyalty and enthusiasm would glorify their honor with great labor feats as befitting absolute defenders and implementers of the Party's policies, he had a photo session with them. -0-

d087f7540d3b586bb87a65b6b8c2319a.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Naval Base under Construction
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 12 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Nov. 11 gave field guidance at the construction of major naval base on the east coast, which is being accelerated under the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress and the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Party Central Committee.
He was accompanied by Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and officials in the field of design.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was told about the progress of the project by commanding officers on the spot.

He referred to the orientation and prospect for building the centre of the Korean-style naval command, the center of naval culture and the center of naval combat capability as early as possible and building up the infrastructure of the naval base.

Saying that the prospect of the construction of the modern naval city is optimistic as there are the firm strategic plan of our Party and the high enthusiasm of the entire Party, the whole army and all the people who are enthusiastically responding to it, he clarified the strategic importance of the construction of the naval base.

He said that as the construction of the modern naval base is a crucial core undertaking directly related to the security of our state and the defence of its maritime sovereignty from A to Z, it should be completed without fail at the qualitative level required by the Party Central Committee within the period set by the Party Central Committee.

Comrade Kim Jong Un set forth guidelines on the arrangement of strategic elements for thoroughly realizing the modernization, multi-functionalization and fortification of the base and assigned important measures for the full-scale progress of the construction of the naval port including the powerful reinforcement of the commanding force of the project and the increase of the building force. -0-

2c5da78e7c36a67344a7e85fab014ae1.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Samjiyon City Tourist Zone under Development
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the tourist zone under development in Samjiyon City on November 15 and 16.
He was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, Kim Jong Gwan, Kim Hwa Song and other officials in charge of construction and designing.

Thanks to the grand plan and personal guidance of Comrade Kim Jong Un for turning Samjiyon City into a combined, all-season mountainous tourist zone with peculiarities to meet the ever-growing cultural and emotional needs of the people and make tourism a major stimulant to regional development, such projects as construction of a ski tourist resort in the area of Mt Pukphothae, expansion of the tourists' climbing route to Mt Paektu, remodeling of Samjiyon Airport and construction of a tourist railway and construction and enlargement of new and existing accommodation, public catering and transport service facilities are progressing apace in Samjiyon City under a year-by-year plan.
On November 15, Comrade Kim Jong Un gave field guidance at Samjiyon Airport undergoing remodeling and expansion and a ski tourist resort under construction in the area of Mt Pukphothae.
He was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the units involved in construction.
He first looked round Samjiyon Airport under remodeling.

Looking at the layout of its terminal, a map showing its panoramic view and the layout of the railway system for Samjiyon City tourist zone, he asked the commanding officers about progress made in the projects.

Referring to the need to give precedence to the remodeling and expansion of the airport in the efforts for transforming Samjiyon City into a peculiar mountainous tourist zone, he said that when this project has been finished the city would be impeccable in its infrastructure and all other elements indispensable for developing tourism, including air and railway transportation, road and service networks, communications, healthcare, sports and accommodation facilities.

Specially mentioning the need to expand the airport runway minutely and responsibly in the light of the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization, he specified the orientation of future construction and the ways for its implementation.

Walking along the railway line stretching in a peculiar way in harmony with the terminal, he said that the Party Central Committee highly appreciates the painstaking efforts of the railway builders dedicating their true patriotism to construction, getting over the unfavourable weather conditions in the northern tip of the country by dint of their strong spiritual strength and courage. He asked the accompanying officials to convey his thanks and pep talks to the builders.
Then he headed for the ski resort under construction in the area of Mt Pukphothae.

In December 2025, he climbed to the top of Mt Pukphothae in biting snowstorm, typical of the northern alpine region of the country. At that time he specified the orientation and ways for developing the area into a special sports-oriented, experiences-giving mountainous tourist resort. Since then, he has energetically steered the project, providing detailed guidance on hundreds of layout plans, formation of powerful construction forces, measures for materials supply.

Going round skiing service center, hotels, hostels, various resting places, blocks of employees' flats and other buildings under construction, Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction, saying that all the structures are really impeccable as they were built in a delicate way to exhibit unique charm and individuality in good harmony with the northern alpine landscape, as required by our Party's Juche-oriented idea of architectural beauty on thoroughly adhering to the principle of practicality, diversity and formative art and its policy on regional construction.

Noting that the more he looked at it, the more admiration he felt at the spectacular scenery reminiscent of a town in the forest, he said that the eye-opening transformation in the area of Mt Pukphothae constitutes an aggregation of the potential our Party has cultivated by directly guiding the construction sector for more than ten years, and serves as a monumental edifice of the era brought about by the inexhaustible strength of the masses who accept as the only guidelines and unconditionally implement the Party's construction policy and instructions.

Saying that it is an important requirement of the Party's policy for regional development to ceaselessly pioneer new realms for promoting the independent development of regions and improving the people's material life and civilization, including exploitation of the resources for tourism, he referred to the principled issues arising in putting the country's tourism on a track of rapid development.
He pointed out some shortcomings revealed in the internal space arrangement and construction of buildings and indicated the ways and measures to correct them.

After looking round the blocks of employees' apartment houses in various shapes, he praised the builders from different provinces for their meticulous work and urged the officials in the construction sector to come up with a methodology for building all the dwellings, to be constructed under the regional development policy, at that level and take measures to put it into practice.

He acquainted himself with the states of skiing tracks and the operation of equipment at the tourist resort in the area of Mt Pukphothae, and gave an instruction on making preparations for their running responsibly.

He advanced important tasks to be fulfilled by the construction sector; for the designing field to intensify the highly competitive campaign for steadily creating and introducing with an innovative eye fresh and various designs in strict accordance with the Party's construction policy, to continuously direct primary efforts to strengthening skilled workers and construction guiding force, and for the construction policy department of the Party Central Committee to reformulate the construction guidelines in detail and establish strict discipline and order whereby all the construction units are required to fulfill the requirements of the guidelines.

On November 16, Comrade Kim Jong Un gave field guidance at tourist resorts in the areas of Mudu Peak and Mt Paektu under construction according to the master plan for construction of Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Zone.
He learned in detail about the construction of hotels, dwellings and public buildings in the area of Mudu Peak.

Stressing the need to properly define the priorities in carrying out the project, make effective use of manpower, materials and equipment, take proper practical measures to strictly ensure the quality of structures, and pay close attention to protecting the ecological environment, he clarified all the tasks related to the project and principled issues arising in working out a construction plan for 2027.

He stated that it is important to spruce up the city of Samjiyon, but it is more important to cultivate patriotism of all the officials and builders through the great transformation and train them to be paragons of creativity capable of reliably supporting the foundation for the country's development.
He climbed Mt Paektu to learn about the modernization of the Hyangdo Station and the cableway stop and the construction project in the area of Lake Chon on the top of Mt Paektu.

All the structures, being built in the holy place of the Korean revolution, constitute one and only monumental edifice representing the development of our architecture although they may be small, he said, stressing the need to ensure their highest quality in minute detail.

The area of Mt Paektu is a scenic spot without parallel in the world as it still has the ecosystem of natural forests and is rich in various resources for tourism, he said, stressing again the economic and cultural effectiveness of the construction of the mountainous tourist zone and its prospective significance.

Noting that Mt Paektu is a holy mountain where our revolution took its deep and strong root, he said that the mountain, the origin of the great idea which provides a firm guarantee for vigorously carrying on the great revolution, is the most precious revolutionary wealth of our state and people and it is the greatest pride to have such a powerful center for ideological education, the education in the revolutionary traditions.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed the expectation and belief that all the builders would continue to perform praiseworthy labour feats in the vanguard of the construction revolution with the pride of being creators and pioneers adding another chapter of prosperity and development in the present era to the history of the country. -0-

0f19a6fa6a22aa8b88d81a6034ae72e6.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Construction Sites in Riwon and Ragwon Counties of S. Hamgyong Province for Regional Development Policy
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at construction sites in Riwon and Ragwon counties of South Hamgyong Province on November 17 and 18, where the projects for implementing the regional development policy are being carried out.
He was accompanied by major leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence and officials of the construction and designing fields.
On November 17, Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the new offshore farm and fishing village under construction in Riwon County of South Hamgyong Province.
He was greeted by Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, and leading officials of Riwon County.
Comrade Kim Jong Un feasted his eyes on the modern offshore farm and the beautiful residential area.

He highly praised the province for having carried out the construction project at around 98 percent through a dynamic campaign since it pledged to build an advanced offshore farm in the county of Riwon by provincial efforts in hearty response to the Party Central Committee's Regional Development 20×10 Policy and built one hundred and dozens of modern flats for its employees, alongside such huge projects as construction of the Ragwonpho Branch Greenhouse Farm and new dwelling houses for 1 000 households in the city of Hamhung.

He said that the province has taken the lead in implementing the Party policy that requires all the regions to secure a firm guarantee for independent development by effectively exploiting their own economic resources, adding that really great is the ever-soaring spirit of the officials and working people in the province determined to carve out their future by themselves, confident about the validity and truthfulness of the Party policy.

Going round several places of the offshore farm, including a wharf, processing ground, quick-freezing ground and integrated control room, he learned in detail about the construction and preparations for the running of the offshore farm.

He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that Riwon County has created one hundred hectares of fish culture ground by introducing the excellent experience of the offshore farms in Sinpho City and Ragwon County.

The seas of our country have good prospects for the stable, systematic development of shallow-sea culture as they are favorable to fish culture in terms of water quality, depth and temperature, etc. and not polluted, he said, adding that the coastal cities and counties should regard it as a vital undertaking to ensure their regional economic growth and improve the basic material and cultural living standards of their people by making good use of the inexhaustible marine resources and conditions.

Now that great construction projects, such as housing and industrial construction projects, are being conducted on a nationwide scale, special attention should be paid to protecting the ecological environment, he noted, adding that the protection of the ecological environment is an important undertaking directly concerning the priceless lives of our people and our future. And he underlined the need for the relevant sector to adopt more advanced organizational and structural policy and methodology and take appropriate measures for environmental protection.

Appreciating the efforts of the scientific and educational research institutes which optimized the whole process of shallow-sea culture and put the operation and management on a modern basis by establishing an integrated production system in the Riwon County Offshore Farm, he called on the scientific circle to achieve more successes conducive to implementation of the Party's regional development policy.
On a factory ship, he acquainted himself with the preparations for its operation and underscored the need to pay close attention to the living conditions of culturists.

He clarified important tasks related to construction; to develop a methodology for the sustained growth of productivity in conformity with ever-changing seasonal maritime ecological environment, take measures in advance to protect breeding grounds from typhoons, tidal waves and other natural disasters and enhance the role and responsibility of the construction supervisory institutions.

Touring the modern residential district for the employees built by the province, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that all the requirements of the Party policy on housing construction have been fulfilled and all the buildings impeccably built in various styles to preserve their peculiarities.
He praised the builders, saying that all the elements of the interior of apartment houses, in every particular, vividly reflect their profound sincerity and meticulous working manner.

He said that the eye-opening transformation taking place in Riwon County is a proud witness to the worthwhile struggle, which can be brought about only by the absolute adherents and staunch implementers of the Party's policies, and is the fruit of the painstaking efforts of the officials and working people in the province.
On November 18, Comrade Kim Jong Un guided the construction projects for implementing the regional development policy in Ragwon County, South Hamgyong Province.
He was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the army units involved in construction.

The soldier-builders are performing great labour feats by turning all out in the drive for implementing the on-site instructions given by him on July 3, 2026. Thanks to their patriotic loyalty, the construction of the Ragwon County Hospital, leisure complex and regional industry factories is now progressing apace at the final stage.

Going round the light industrial factories, hospital and leisure complex under construction in Ragwon County, Comrade Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the progress made in the projects and the construction of buildings.

Calling for focusing on further improving the whole character and cultural level of structures in the construction projects for regional development policy, he stressed the importance of enhancing professionalism of leading officials in the construction sector and supervisory organs in particular.

He set forth the important tasks for successfully completing the projects; to thoroughly tackle empiricism in the construction sector, put the production of finishing building materials on a specialized, industrial and systematic basis, adjust the size of regional industrial factories to specific regional conditions, conduct examination of technological drawings and inspection of structural systems in a responsible manner and properly classify the categories of service in leisure complexes so as to preserve the peculiarities of each region.

The construction projects taking place on a nationwide scale for implementing the regional development policy constitute a gigantic revolution for bringing about the simultaneous and balanced development of our country and improving the basic living standards of the regional people, he said, adding that it is the highest honour and glory bestowed by the times and history on our army to take charge of the sacred revolutionary struggle.

He highly praised the soldier-builders for having done a really good extra deed of building fashionable apartment houses for the local railway workers, mindful of the intention of the Party Central Committee which placed the Korean People's Army in the vanguard of the struggle for regional transformation, while carrying out the huge project for building regional industrial factories.

He stressed the need for the construction units at all levels to continue to direct primary efforts to the political and ideological education so that all the soldier-builders remain faithful to their honourable duty as members of the army of the Party and the people, cherishing their proud responsibility for bringing earlier the prosperous morrow of the country.

He expressed belief that all the soldier-builders would dynamically steer the development of Korean-style socialist civilization by striving as ever for the prosperity and development of the great country and the wellbeing of its people true to the Party's far-reaching plan for grand construction.
That day Comrade Kim Jong Un inspected the Ragwonpho Branch Greenhouse Farm, the on-going construction of which was undertaken by South Hamgyong Province.

Going round the glass hydroponic greenhouse, semi-arched soil greenhouse, greengrocery and other places, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the province has developed and put into practice innovative technologies conducive to modernization and automation of production and management by relying on its own sci-tech forces.

Noting that the eye-opening successes made in South Hamgyong Province are attributable to the efforts of the provincial Party committee, which has proficiently and responsibly played the role of an organizer, firmly regarding it as its essential and priority task for regional development to strengthen the provincial sci-tech forces and construction workforce, he said that he was deeply impressed by the provincial officials' policy-oriented insight and revolutionary and responsible working manner. Then he took measures in connection with the preparations for the branch greenhouse farm operation.

He repeatedly stressed the need for the whole country to emulate the spirit and working manner of South Hamgyong Province which has perfectly laid the foundations for independent development one after another with the absolute belief in the Party policy and the confidence and fighting spirit to bring earlier the happy future by its own efforts.

He sincerely hoped that the officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province would fulfill the role of vanguard and standard-bearer in intensifying the campaign for three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural - and implementing the Party's regional development policy, dynamically propel the drive for regional prosperity and development and thus achieve bigger successes. -0-

f4a39ed18a2bceb3f84a1761f010fd35.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Kim Jong Suk Naval University
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at Kim Jong Suk Naval University on November 18.
He was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
Senior Vice Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, and the teaching staff and students of the university courteously greeted him in profound reverence.

Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the revolutionary museum, the room for combined military studies, the combined training room and other places of the university, guided by leading officials of the university.

He said that the strategic significance of the naval university, whose primary duty is to train professional naval commanders, is remarkably increasing, now that our navy is evolving into the high-tech service and multi-functional combined army branch.

In particular, the ever-growing importance of defending the maritime sovereignty, the core aspect of our national security, and the current situation witnessing sustained confrontation with the most wicked enemies urgently call for training more able naval combat system experts and commanding officers proficient at modern warfare, he stressed.

Saying that it is the heavy revolutionary task, consistently stressed by the Party, for the military education sector to reliably and firmly ensure the mightiness and invincibility of our revolutionary armed forces not only at present but also in the future, he learned in detail about the educational programme and contents, educational system and situation of the university before making a judgment.

Noting that the changed environment and ever-escalating challenges call for pushing ahead with building a powerful navy as the first strategic task, and therefore, it arises as a crucial issue to turn the university, a pedigree establishment for training naval commanders, into a modern military education center and train all its students into knowledgeable and action-oriented commanding officers, well-versed in the art of combat, he gave important instructions for doing so.

Watching the teachers and students involved in various commanding drills and special training at operation study rooms and simulator training rooms, he specified the tasks for modernizing the university's education.
That day he had a photo taken with the teaching staff and students of the university in commemoration of his visit.

He expressed expectation and belief that the teaching staff and students of the university would work harder to fulfill their responsible and honourable duty for successful implementation of the Party policy of bolstering up the naval forces and for the great glory and eternal prosperity of the navy which has started its journey toward a bright future with high ambition and ideal. -0-

9a2c0ab0af5e6a119cfda4fc88bcb54b.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects School Fixtures Factory and Educational Apparatus Factory under Construction
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 21 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the School Fixtures Factory and the Educational Apparatus Factory under construction on November 20.

He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Kim Sung Du, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, and leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the School Fixtures Factory under construction.
He was greeted by commanding officers of the army unit involved in the construction, leading officials of the factory, and officials in the designing and other relevant sectors.
Going round some parts of the factory, he acquainted himself in detail with construction and preparations for installation of equipment.

He highly praised the soldier-builders for ensuring the quality of structures at the highest level with their great sincerity for the rising generations, true to the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee which regards the education of the rising generations as a top priority state affair.
At the products exhibition room of the factory, he examined the samples of school fixtures of all indices to be produced by the factory.

As the point of view on the science and education precisely means the clearest expression of our revolutionaries' outlook on the future generations and the revolution, the production of the teaching aids and furnishings for primary and middle schools, colleges and universities means substantial and comprehensive investment in the education of the future generations, he noted.

He stressed the need to standardize the production of teaching tools, according to students' ages, physiques, courses and school levels, and to fix the production capacity after scientifically considering the future demand by numbers.

The construction of the educational infrastructure is the most basic and vital undertaking in laying material and technological foundations which can guarantee reliably and substantially the implementation of the policy of radical improvement in education in the new century, he said, adding that it is the most worthwhile of all the undertakings being carried out by our Party for national prosperity and development and for the people and rising generations.
Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the combined production buildings, which house major and auxiliary production lines, and the cultural and welfare facilities for the employees.

Saying that he was really pleased to see a special factory built for meeting the nation-wide demands for the teaching tools both in quality and quantity, he gave detailed instructions on the issues of completing and running the factory; using the finishing building materials in a way of preserving the characteristics of industrial buildings, organizing a specialized equipment-assembling unit, producing teaching tools and their supplements at the same time and taking proper measures for the supply of raw and other materials.
Then he gave field guidance at the Educational Apparatus Factory under construction.
He was greeted by leading officials of the factory, officials of the construction unit and officials in the designing and other relevant sectors.

After being briefed on the layout and the design of the factory, he visited the products exhibition room, material-preparing, plastic-processing, metal-processing and assembling shops and other places.

Noting that another precious asset, which will give impetus to the radical qualitative updating and leaps forward of science and education in the period of unprecedented transformation in socialist construction, has been provided, he called for ensuring the successful radical improvement in education in the new era by laying reliable foundations for surely building the most advanced and finest education under a great plan for developing the nation's education into a world-class one.
At the products exhibition room he appreciated the samples of experimental apparatuses for primary and middle school students.

Our Party's ambitious goal for the qualitative development of education can be successfully attained only when we realize the qualitative strengthening of educators, alongside the qualitative improvement of the educational conditions and environments and the modernization of the educational contents and ways aimed at increasing students' analysis, brainstorming and application abilities, he said, making special mention of the significance of the supply of apparatuses for experiment and practice in improving the practical training for promoting students' understanding ability and helping them acquire practical knowledge.

Now that our education is following the road of remarkable transformation, it is important to successfully carry out all the undertakings directly related to educational development under a long-term plan, he said, setting forth the principled tasks for doing so.

Praising once again the builders and officials concerned for the remarkable fruits they brought by dedicating their sincerity to the progress of education, the soil for developing the most important resources of the country and an engine for national development, he expressed the expectation that the School Fixtures Factory, the Educational Apparatus Factory and the School Things Factory, the construction of which are highly prioritized by the Party, would be successfully completed. -0-
